summary: Add a paired-owner authenticated Opal UV policy endpoint whose validation consumes a versioned shared policy contract, while it remains unable to issue WLED mutations until trusted local readiness evidence exists.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing paired Owner PWA, authenticated Opal local control gateway, canonical AUX UV policy, and hardware fail-dark gates; follows existing /api/aux/control route and does not create a controller or raw WLED path.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Cart local Owner control client and staged Opal local-control package only.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert this source commit. No device, production, or configuration mutation is part of this change.
scoped_evidence.limitations: The endpoint and Deno/JavaScript backend consume the same versioned JSON policy contract, but Opal does not yet have trusted local commissioning state, verified hardware profile, fresh AUX identity/runtime readback, or accepted unpaired-client isolation. It validates requests and returns 503 with mutationIssued:false. No local UV actuation or hardware acceptance is claimed.
